title: Epitaph
identity: Harold Fortuin’s Epitaph is an alto saxophone and piano work dated 1991. Dorn lists DORN0164, commission by Christopher Creviston and a 1991 premiere with pianist Karen Koch. The composer’s archived site links an Epitaph MP3; the performance audio was not auditioned.

evidence.claim: A Rochester archival finding aid records Epitaph (1991) for alto saxophone and piano and identifies a related cassette recording in the Harold Fortuin collection.
evidence.source_name: Eastman School of Music Sibley Music Library finding aid

evidence.claim: Composer’s archived website links an Epitaph MP3.
Dorn listing records DORN0164, Creviston commission and premiere with pianist Karen Koch on March 21, 1991.
